Res.Caption: Attribute Description

Res.Caption: Active
Res.FullDescription: The Is Active flag will turn the query on and off. Queries must be active to be considered to collect data and for instantaneous extraction. In-active queries by default do not show up on filter grids. The entered query will not be validated when it is in-active

Res.Caption: Faulty
Res.FullDescription: Queries marked as Is Faulty have generated errors. See the service tasks logs and the notes attached to this query for details.
